stemMd: Which statement must be true in every permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Amber must not be in position 1.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Jade must not be in position 5.

explanationMd:
Combine the ordering and placement constraints rather than assuming one example is unique. The statement "Jade must not be in position 5." holds in all 10 permitted orders. Generate the cases by placing any fixed-position item and adjacent block first, then discard arrangements that violate a remaining rule. For each alternative, an explicit permitted counterexample appears in its feedback.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal
- Amber → Pearl → Jade → Opal → Coral
- Opal → Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral
- Opal → Jade → Amber → Pearl → Coral
- Opal → Jade → Coral → Amber → Pearl
- Opal → Jade → Coral → Pearl → Amber
- Opal → Jade → Pearl → Amber → Coral
- Opal → Pearl → Amber → Jade → Coral
- Pearl → Amber → Jade → Coral → Opal
- Pearl → Amber → Jade → Opal → Coral

distractorRationale.a: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.c: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral → Opal. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.b: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Opal → Amber → Pearl → Jade → Coral. Thus this statement is not necessary.

independentSolve.workingNotes: Blind re-solve in the 5 November 2026 AI audit of this expansion (the review packet held no key, explanation or distractor notes; status "verified_key_agreement"; it checked for competing defensible answers and flagged none): Independently enumerated all 120 permutations of Amber, Coral, Jade, Opal, Pearl. Rules Amber and Pearl must occupy consecutive positions, in either order. Jade must precede Coral. Jade must not be in position 1. Opal must not be in position 3. leave 10 valid orders: Amber>Pearl>Jade>Coral>Opal; Amber>Pearl>Jade>Opal>Coral; Opal>Amber>Pearl>Jade>Coral; Opal>Jade>Amber>Pearl>Coral; Opal>Jade>Coral>Amber>Pearl; Opal>Jade>Coral>Pearl>Amber; Opal>Jade>Pearl>Amber>Coral; Opal>Pearl>Amber>Jade>Coral; Pearl>Amber>Jade>Coral>Opal; Pearl>Amber>Jade>Opal>Coral. Choice true counts: a=8, b=3, c=10, d=2; necessary requires all matches.
